Audio and Video Editor (hereinafter referred to as the "App") is developed and provided by us. We understand the importance of personal information to you and are committed to protecting your privacy. Before using this App, please carefully read and understand this Privacy Policy. By starting to use this App, you agree to its entirety.\n
1. How We Collect and Use Your Information\n
This App integrates with third-party advertising services and displays advertisements when you use the App. To optimize ad display performance and calculate advertising data, we may collect the following information:\n
Device information: This includes device model, operating system version, and app version. This information is used to ensure that ads are displayed correctly on your device.\n
Ad interaction data: This includes the number of times you view and click on an ad. This data is anonymous and used only for ad display performance and revenue calculation purposes. It is not associated with your personally identifiable information.\n
Important: We do not collect personally identifiable information such as your name, phone number, or email address.\n
2. How We Use Cookies and Similar Technologies\n
The advertising service providers in this App may use cookies or other similar technologies to collect the aforementioned device information and ad interaction data to provide more relevant advertising content. These technologies are independently operated by advertising service providers.\n
3. How We Share and Publicly Disclose Your Information\n We promise not to share, transfer, or publicly disclose your personal information to any third-party company, organization, or individual without your explicit consent, except in the following circumstances:\n
To the extent permitted by law: To comply with applicable laws, regulations, legal process, or government mandates.\n
To protect the safety of this app and its users: For example, to investigate, prevent, or address fraud, security, or technical issues.\n
We only share anonymous ad interaction data with the aforementioned advertising service providers to enable ad display and revenue settlement.\n
4. Your Rights\n
As a user, you have the right to choose whether to continue using this app at any time. If you do not wish us to collect the aforementioned ad interaction data, you can choose to stop using this app.\n
5. How We Protect Your Information\n We implement reasonable security measures to protect the anonymous data we collect to prevent data loss, misuse, unauthorized access, or disclosure. However, please understand that no security measures can be 100% secure. \n
6. Privacy Policy Updates\n We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If there are significant changes, we will notify you prominently within the app or through other appropriate means. The revised Privacy Policy will take effect upon posting.\n
7. Contact Us\n If you have any questions or suggestions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the following means:\n
Email: running_in_storm@qq.com\n
